    Endpoint coefficient compiler for BGRS Figure 16 #

    The literal Figure-16 source has six occurrences but may be realized on only three ambient objects. Consequently its scalar projection must remember source occurrences, not merely ambient endpoints. This file records the thirteen supported entries of that projection: six identities, five arrows, and the two lower-branch paths through the central arrow.

    Once the finite table is compatible with left and right whiskering by the five displayed arrows, thinness extends those equations to arbitrary paths and produces the Hom-bifunctor retraction used by the cleaving argument.
